items.title: Task-local preparation blocker aborts global expired-run recovery
items.root_note: Post-initialization runtime recovery defect, selected for an early repair. R29 strengthens R02 with actual public fleet/task creation/start and synthetic readiness, clock and held model, without SQL-created state: lost lab readiness plus an expired lease makes two unrelated claims throw and rolls cleanup back. Restoring readiness permits recovery and an unrelated claim; the stale lease remains rejected and the 1000 microusd reserve remains held. A separate same-process second-Coordinator constructor control recovers despite missing lab readiness; initial startup failure, a real crash/restart failure, frequency and financial loss are not established. Final adversarial review supports P2. Isolate only known per-task preparation blockers; do not swallow unexpected database or invariant errors.
